howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.hub: Create a {hub} pointing to a trigger voice channel. Anyone who joins it gets their own temporary channel and is moved there.
howItWorks.controls: The channel is deleted automatically when it empties. The owner controls everything from the {panel} (buttons) or with {command}: lock, hide, limit, rename, permit, reject, transfer and claim.
howItWorks.placement: The control panel can live in the channel's {chat} or in a {channel} (configurable per hub).
howItWorks.preferences: Member preferences (name, limit, locked…) are {remembered} and restored on the next channel they create.

active.intro: Temporary channels active right now on this server.
active.empty: No temporary channels active at the moment.

hubs.loadFailed: Failed to load hubs. Is the Voice module active on this server?
hubs.intro: "Join-to-create" channels: when a member joins one, they get a temporary voice channel.
